memory_update.text: AMKR should remain in the Layer 1B universe as the clearest US-listed OSAT beneficiary candidate, but HBM-specific revenue must be verified because current evidence is advanced-packaging/AI/HPC exposure rather than pure HBM overflow.

summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe around HBM and advanced-packaging backend capacity. The reference lane is TSM because CoWoS/2.5D capacity anchors the AI advanced-packaging bottleneck. The underfollowed lane favors US-listed OSAT, probe-card, inspection/metrology, and test-equipment companies where HBM or HBM-adjacent advanced packaging is material enough to verify but not always visible in AI screens. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
